name: brickplace
description: A long-running collaborative map game: place bricks, hammer cells, stack shields.

scripts.verify: biome ci . && turbo run typecheck test build
scripts.dev: node tools/dev-vars.mjs && pnpm --filter @brickplace/client build && wrangler d1 migrations apply ACCOUNTS --local -c workers/gateway/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply STANDINGS --local -c workers/gateway/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler kv key put team-daily-cells 1000000 --binding MODERATION --local -c workers/gateway/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler dev -c workers/gateway/wrangler.jsonc -c workers/realtime/wrangler.jsonc -c workers/game/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.dev:admin: node tools/dev-vars.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply ADMIN_DB --local --persist-to workers/gateway/.wrangler/state -c workers/admin/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply ACCOUNTS --local --persist-to workers/gateway/.wrangler/state -c workers/admin/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler dev -c workers/admin/wrangler.jsonc --port 8788 --persist-to workers/gateway/.wrangler/state
